metadata.datasource: Measured off Polaroid Corporation, T-53, T-553 and T-803 B&W High Speed Instant Peel-Apart Coaterless Film, Film Data Sheet (1999): the print's characteristic curve at 70 F (21 C), its spectral sensitivity and its MTF, vector plots. A positive and the print at once, seen by reflection: the curve is the print's density, D-min 0.100 (the paper's white) to D-max 1.88. Mid-grey where it reads the sheet's reference density, 0.75 (18% grey on a print), on the sheet's relative axis; the pack carries the sheet's prints at 55 F and 95 F (13 and 35 C) too, its cold and hot processing. The spectral sensitivity continues past its plotted ends at its own final gradient and is balanced so an 18% grey exposes it to 1. Filter factors in daylight and tungsten from it: Wratten 47 5.8 and 10.0 (sheet 6.3 and 11.2); Wratten 58 15.1 and 11.9 (sheet 10.0 and 11.2); Wratten 8 2.8 and 1.6 (sheet 2.0 and 1.4); Wratten 25 6.0 and 2.8 (sheet 5.6 and 2.8). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
